variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
